description: A free trial sign-up screen with a hero image, email and password fields, and a terms checkbox.
overview: A hero image sits above an `InputAccessoryBar` with email and password inputs; the password shows a five-level strength meter as you type. A `Checkbox` with a `Label` accepts the terms, and the Start free trial `Button` in the `BottomBar` stays disabled until the form is valid, then shows a welcome screen. A sign-in link sits below.
usage: Replace `IMAGE` and the copy with your own. `onSubmit` receives the email and password, and `onSignIn` handles the sign-in link. The hero photo is an Unsplash placeholder.
